levels.text: Lands for 150% Weapon damage, knocks back

name: Ravenous Lunge
notes: In game (hwp_pri_coh_ravenous_lunge, tested): the lunge hits enemies within 50 of the landing for 100/150% of the main hand's damage; rare knocks back. plan-forgemaster-bosses 20261022-144616 (the forced lunge hits a target dummy 30 px past the body; 40 bodies at a 16% chance).
summary: Your flesh-eating lunge slams into enemies where you land, damaging them before you start to eat.
